verdict.rationale: LibreChat is self-hosted and lets users pick API-based model providers, which architecturally implies the operator/user controls whether conversation data ever leaves their infrastructure or reaches a provider that trains on it, but the evidence pack contains no explicit privacy policy, data-processing agreement, or documented 'opt out of training' setting — a community comment merely raises the question of whether history vs API usage differs in training without LibreChat-specific confirmation. missing for 10: explicit LibreChat documentation on data retention/training opt-out, provider-level DPA/zero-retention guarantees, and confirmation that self-hosted mode fully isolates data from any training pipeline.
